description: This file contains unit tests for the AbstractConfig class in the org.eclipse.hono.config package. It verifies behavior related to key and certificate configuration options, including loading different key formats and handling missing files.

classes.name: AbstractConfigTest
classes.description: Unit test class for testing configuration handling in AbstractConfig, including key store and key/cert path validation.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes a minimal instance of AbstractConfig before each test.

methods.name: testPfxConfig
methods.description: Tests loading a PFX keystore configuration and checks if the returned options are of type PfxOptions.

methods.name: testPemConfig
methods.description: Tests loading PEM key and certificate files and verifies the returned options are PemKeyCertOptions.

methods.name: testInvalidConfig1
methods.description: Tests overriding key format to PKCS12 when supplying PEM files, expecting null options.

methods.name: testInvalidConfig2
methods.description: Tests setting a keystore and overriding the format to PEM, expecting null options.

methods.name: testMissingFile1
methods.description: Checks behavior when keystore file does not exist; expects IllegalArgumentException.

methods.name: testMissingFile2
methods.description: Checks behavior when key file does not exist; expects IllegalArgumentException.

methods.name: testMissingFile3
methods.description: Checks behavior when cert file does not exist; expects IllegalArgumentException.

methods.name: testMissingFile4
methods.description: Checks behavior when trust store file does not exist; expects IllegalArgumentException.
